chunks.title: 上下文与说话人共同决定情绪
chunks.sourceText: DialogueGCN begins from two conversational dependencies. Self-dependency captures a speaker's emotional inertia across turns, while inter-speaker dependency captures how other participants influence that speaker. Both are needed when the same words change meaning across interactions.
chunks.zhTranslation: DialogueGCN 从两类对话依赖出发：自我依赖表示同一说话人在多轮中的情绪惯性，说话人间依赖表示其他参与者如何影响该说话人。当相同词语随互动改变含义时，两者都很重要。
chunks.zhExplanation: 论坛图中可分别建立同作者历史边和回复对象边，使这两个假设成为可直接消融的结构，而不是隐含在一个长文本输入里。

blocks.text: DialogueGCN begins from two conversational dependencies. Self-dependency captures a speaker's emotional inertia across turns, while inter-speaker dependency captures how other participants influence that speaker. Both are needed when the same words change meaning across interactions.

chunks.title: 先编码顺序上下文
chunks.sourceText: The first stage uses a bidirectional gated recurrent encoder to obtain context-aware utterance representations. This sequence model supplies local conversational information before the graph explicitly reorganizes interactions by speaker and temporal relation.
chunks.zhTranslation: 第一阶段使用双向门控循环编码器生成带上下文的发言表示。序列模型先提供局部对话信息，随后图结构再按说话人与时间关系显式重组互动。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这意味着 DialogueGCN 的提升不能简单归因于 GCN。对照实验应包括仅文本编码器、文本加序列上下文、再加图结构。

blocks.text: The first stage uses a bidirectional gated recurrent encoder to obtain context-aware utterance representations. This sequence model supplies local conversational information before the graph explicitly reorganizes interactions by speaker and temporal relation.

chunks.title: 发言是节点，关系是边
chunks.sourceText: Each utterance becomes a graph node, and directed edges connect it to utterances inside a context window. Edge relations encode the source speaker, target speaker, and whether the neighboring utterance lies in the past or future of the current turn.
chunks.zhTranslation: 每个发言被构造成图节点，有向边把它连接到上下文窗口内的其他发言。边关系编码源说话人、目标说话人，以及相邻发言位于当前轮次的过去还是未来。
chunks.zhExplanation: 论坛场景不能机械照搬线性窗口。父回复边表达真实交互，时间邻接边补充局部语境，同作者边则表达用户状态连续性。

blocks.text: Each utterance becomes a graph node, and directed edges connect it to utterances inside a context window. Edge relations encode the source speaker, target speaker, and whether the neighboring utterance lies in the past or future of the current turn.

chunks.title: 注意力决定邻居权重
chunks.sourceText: DialogueGCN assigns attention-derived weights to neighboring utterances so that not every connected turn contributes equally. The normalized score is computed within the chosen context window, after which relation-specific transformations propagate information across the graph.
chunks.zhTranslation: DialogueGCN 为邻居发言分配注意力权重，使所有相连轮次不必等量贡献。分数在选定的上下文窗口内归一化，随后由关系特定的变换在图中传播信息。
chunks.zhExplanation: 注意力权重可以用于调试相关上下文，但不能直接解释为情绪成因；它只说明模型在该预测中使用了哪些邻居表示。

blocks.text: DialogueGCN assigns attention-derived weights to neighboring utterances so that not every connected turn contributes equally. The normalized score is computed within the chosen context window, after which relation-specific transformations propagate information across the graph.

chunks.title: 关系感知图卷积
chunks.sourceText: Relation-aware graph convolution aggregates messages with parameters tied to edge type, then a second graph layer refines the representation. This design lets the model treat same-speaker history differently from cross-speaker influence instead of collapsing all context into one pool.
chunks.zhTranslation: 关系感知图卷积使用与边类型绑定的参数聚合消息，再通过第二层图网络细化表示。模型因此可以区别处理同一说话人的历史与跨说话人影响，而不是把所有上下文压成一个池。
chunks.zhExplanation: 如果自建数据用户很多，按具体用户定义关系会爆炸。应使用“同作者/不同作者/父回复/时间方向”等可泛化关系类型。

blocks.text: Relation-aware graph convolution aggregates messages with parameters tied to edge type, then a second graph layer refines the representation. This design lets the model treat same-speaker history differently from cross-speaker influence instead of collapsing all context into one pool.

chunks.title: 融合后完成分类
chunks.sourceText: The final classifier combines sequential context features with graph-refined speaker-level features. The architecture therefore preserves both local order and relational structure, rather than forcing one representation to replace the other.
chunks.zhTranslation: 最终分类器融合顺序上下文特征与图网络细化后的说话人层特征。该架构同时保留局部顺序和关系结构，而不是让一种表示完全替代另一种。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这张总体结构图适合直接指导复现时的张量检查：逐阶段确认 utterance 编码、图节点数、边类型和分类输入维度。

blocks.text: The final classifier combines sequential context features with graph-refined speaker-level features. The architecture therefore preserves both local order and relational structure, rather than forcing one representation to replace the other.

chunks.title: 结果依赖数据与指标
chunks.sourceText: DialogueGCN is evaluated on several conversational emotion benchmarks with dataset-specific label spaces and metrics. Its gains support relational modeling on those datasets, but they do not establish that every graph relation transfers unchanged to new communities or asynchronous discussions.
chunks.zhTranslation: DialogueGCN 在多个对话情绪基准上评估，而各数据集拥有不同的标签空间和指标。结果支持关系建模在这些数据上的价值，但不能证明同样的图关系会原样迁移到新社区或异步讨论。
chunks.zhExplanation: 复现报告必须保留原数据集指标，再单独报告论坛数据。跨数据集标签映射后得到的分数不应与原论文数字直接横比。

blocks.text: DialogueGCN is evaluated on several conversational emotion benchmarks with dataset-specific label spaces and metrics. Its gains support relational modeling on those datasets, but they do not establish that every graph relation transfers unchanged to new communities or asynchronous discussions.

blocks.caption: Graph ablations for the forum extension.
rows: How much signal is in the current post?

chunks.title: 从线性对话改成回复树
chunks.sourceText: A forum adaptation can replace the linear dialogue window with a reply tree while retaining utterance nodes and relation-aware propagation. Parent-child direction, same-author continuity, temporal distance, and missing or deleted posts must be defined before training and tested through controlled ablations.
chunks.zhTranslation: 论坛适配可以把线性对话窗口替换为回复树，同时保留发言节点与关系感知传播。父子回复方向、同作者连续性、时间距离以及缺失或删除帖子都必须在训练前定义，并通过受控消融检验。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这是最有研究价值的扩展，但应先做最小图：父回复加同作者两类边。边类型越多，数据稀疏和过拟合风险越高。

blocks.text: A forum adaptation can replace the linear dialogue window with a reply tree while retaining utterance nodes and relation-aware propagation. Parent-child direction, same-author continuity, temporal distance, and missing or deleted posts must be defined before training and tested through controlled ablations.
